title: University of Kansas Debate program named best in nation
summary_en: The University of Kansas Debate program was identified as the No. 1 debate program in the country in a 2026 ranking of the “Top 50 Competitive College Debate Programs in the U.S.” from American Liberty Media.
title_cn: University of Kansas Debate program named best in nation

title: Audio-Reader’s Audio Sale returns to Lawrence Public Library for 3-day event
summary_en: Audio-Reader’s Audio Sale will take place Sept. 11-13, offering bargains on more than 100 pieces of vintage and modern audio equipment as well as over 1,000 vinyl records, along with cassette tapes, musical instruments, CDs and other unique audio finds.
title_cn: Audio-Reader’s Audio Sale returns to Lawrence Public Library for 3-day event

title: KU sociologist Mehrangiz Najafizadeh earns rare third Fulbright U.S. Scholar Award
summary_en: Mehrangiz Najafizadeh, associate professor of sociology at KU, has earned her third Fulbright U.S. Scholar Award. She will teach and conduct research in Azerbaijan during the spring 2027 semester, offering courses and interdisciplinary seminars while continuing her sociological research. title: New book ‘Leading Without Apology’ provides guidance to women to advance to educational leadership roles
summary_en: Women make up a majority of teachers and education professionals, but they are underrepresented in school leadership roles. A new book by KU scholars aims to help women anticipate the challenges to advancing and advocate for themselves to take on such roles.
title_cn: New book ‘Leading Without Apology’ provides guidance to women to advance to educational leadership roles
